Links: [{"title":"dwn.alza.cz","url":"https://dwn.alza.cz/manual/160634"},{"title":"Skupina produktů:","url":"https://www.drmax.cz/cbd-star-red-light-panel-300-w-terapie-cervenym-svetlem"},{"title":"Hlavní obsah","url":"https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/magazin-zivotni-styl-posvitte-si-cervene-proc-v-cervenem-svetle-jedou-sportovci-herci-i-astronauti-265068"},{"title":"Červené světlo, jak funguje terapie lampou?","url":"https://www.drmax.cz/zeptejte-se-lekarnika/cervene-svetlo-jak-funguje-terapie-lampou"},{"title":"cesi objevuji terapii cervenym svetlem roste z ni dalsi miliardovy byznys","url":"https://forbes.cz/cesi-objevuji-terapii-cervenym-svetlem-roste-z-ni-dalsi-miliardovy-byznys/"},{"title":"Welzo Max Red Light Therapy Full Body Panel - Professional Max verze 5","url":"https://welzo.com/cs-eu/products/welzo-max-red-light-therapy-full-body-panel-professional-max-verze-5"},{"title":"16528 jaky panel pro terapii cervenym a near infra red svetlem","url":"https://www.poradte.cz/nejen-pro-zeny/16528-jaky-panel-pro-terapii-cervenym-a-near-infra-red-svetlem.html"},{"title":"Biohacking, longevity a moderní zdraví","url":"https://www.newstream.cz/enjoy/biohacking-terapie-cervenym-svetlem"},{"title":"manual rl300 a2 6a5766f897d218.71495783","url":"https://pilulka.s3-central.vshosting.cloud/vms-prod-cs/vms/product/listing/2026/07/manual_rl300_a2_6a5766f897d218.71495783.pdf"}]

The search returned mostly Czech-language sources on red light therapy (RLT) panels, and they fall into three groups.

- **Product listings and manuals:** These describe panels for home and wellness use, with specs such as LED counts, wavelengths, and power. One manual from the Glow RL300A describes the method as photobiomodulation, and its claims about sleep and recovery are marketing statements, not established findings. [index 9-5, 9-8] A Welzo listing advertises a 600 W full-body panel. [index 6-3] Mito Light and Lighthacker panels are compared on wattage and wavelengths in a Czech forum thread. [index 7-4, 7-5]
- **Evidence review:** A Newstream article says the clinical evidence varies by use. It is strongest for pain, wound healing, and some skin conditions, and weaker for sleep and cognitive effects. [index 8-3]
- **Testimonials and media:** Forbes Czechia and Seznam Zprávy quote athletes and entrepreneurs praising the therapy. [index 5-8, 3-6] These are anecdotal, and the Forbes piece also repeats claims about serotonin and mood that I could not verify here. [index 5-1]

Overall, the evidence is strongest for skin and pain or healing uses, and the sleep, mood, and performance claims are much less established. Product pages are promotional. Anyone with a medical condition, or who takes medication such as warfarin, should ask a doctor first. One pharmacy Q&A raises that concern about warfarin. [index 4-3]
